headline: Lake Erie join Tiffin and Thomas More at the top
dek: Lake Erie beat Ohio Dominican on Thursday to draw level with Tiffin and Thomas More at the top of the table, none of them beaten in conference play. Cedarville, who had shared the lead with Tiffin, lost at home to Malone. Lake Erie's two defeats both came away from home before conference play opened.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The scoring sits with the sides at the top of the table: Lake Erie's seventeen goals are more than Kentucky Wesleyan and Northwood have managed together.

wire.line: No perfect conference record survives: Cedarville lost at home to Malone and Tiffin drew, letting Lake Erie and Thomas More draw level.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches have gone past their date with no published result. Kentucky Wesleyan account for most of them, and Walsh's visit to Pitt-Johnstown is the other.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Tiffin have conceded five goals all season and have lost only once, at home to Charleston on the opening day; since then they have won four and drawn three.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ohio Dominican have conceded eighteen goals, and have won once, drawn twice and lost four times.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Alex Banjac has scored five goals for Lake Erie from fifteen shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nick Cherry has kept five clean sheets in goal for Tiffin.

last_match.line: Tiffin have yet to lose a conference match; Walsh have yet to win one.

next_match.line: Lake Erie are unbeaten in conference play; Findlay's only conference defeat came away to Kentucky Wesleyan.
